# Lag your pipes before the frost

Home insurers are asking householders to lag pipes in lofts, garages and along outside walls before the first frost, Home Matters Scotland reports. Foam lagging is cheap and easy to fit.

Insurers also suggest two other habits for the colder months. If the house will be empty in cold weather, leave the heating on low rather than off. And make sure everyone at home knows how to turn off the water at the stopcock.

None of this takes long. It is easier to do on a dry autumn weekend than on a cold January night, and a lagged pipe is one less thing to think about when the weather turns. If you are not sure where your stopcock is, today is a good day to look.

HomeAssist Emergency Cover is an optional add-on to our home insurance that arranges help with emergencies such as a burst pipe or a broken boiler.
